```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(fastTopics)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


## Differentially expressed genes

```{r}
# Read data
rna_df <- read.csv("rna_for_seurat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Expression matrix: rows = cells, cols = genes
gene_mat <- as.matrix(rna_df[, -(1:6)])

# Metadata
meta <- rna_df[, 1:6]
meta$cell_index <- seq_len(nrow(meta))

dim(gene_mat)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Subsample 100 cells per (treatment, dosage, time)
meta_balanced <- meta %>%
  group_by(treatment, dosage, time) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 100, replace = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Subset expression matrix
gene_mat_balanced <- gene_mat[meta_balanced$cell_index, ]

dim(gene_mat_balanced)

# Fit Poisson NMF topic model
K <- 16  # number of topics

tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(gene_mat_balanced,k = 16,init.method = "random",method = "em",
                      numiter = 20,verbose = "none",
					  control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = FALSE))
tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(gene_mat_balanced,fit0 = tm,method = "scd",numiter = 40,
                      control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = TRUE),
					  verbose = "none")
fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(tm)

# Extract matrices
theta <- fit_multinom$L  # cell-topic proportions (N x K)
beta  <- fit_multinom$F  # topic-gene weights
```


```{r}
# Combine metadata with topic proportions
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))

theta_df <- meta_balanced %>%
  select(-cell_index) %>%
  cbind(theta)

# Average topic proportions within groups
theta_avg <- theta_df %>%
  group_by(treatment, dosage, time, cell_state) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

# Matrix for heatmap
rownames(theta_avg) <- paste(
  theta_avg$treatment,
  theta_avg$dosage,
  theta_avg$time,
  theta_avg$cell_state,
  sep = "_"
)

theta_mat <- as.matrix(theta_avg[, -(1:4)])

# Column annotation
ann_col <- data.frame(
  treatment  = factor(theta_avg$treatment),
  dosage     = factor(theta_avg$dosage),
  time       = factor(theta_avg$time),
  cell_state = factor(theta_avg$cell_state)
)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(theta_mat)

# Heatmap annotation colors
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = ann_col,
  col = list(
    treatment = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$treatment)), "Set2"),
      names = levels(ann_col$treatment)
    ),
    dosage = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$dosage)), "Set1"),
      names = levels(ann_col$dosage)
    ),
    time = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$time)), "Set3"),
      names = levels(ann_col$time)
    ),
    cell_state = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$cell_state)), "Dark2"),
      names = levels(ann_col$cell_state)
    )
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    treatment  = list(title = "Treatment"),
    dosage     = list(title = "Dosage"),
    time       = list(title = "Time"),
    cell_state = list(title = "Cell State")
  )
)

# 6️⃣ Draw the heatmap (no scaling)
Heatmap(
  t(theta_mat),                        # rows = topics, cols = grouped units
  name = "Mean topic proportion",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.1, 0.25), c("#f7fbff", "#6baed6", "#08306b")),  # lighter color scale
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  use_raster = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Groups (avg topic proportions per treatment × dosage × time × cell_state)",
  row_title = "Topics",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Mean Prop"),column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
)
```


```{r}
# Differential expression analysis
de_results <- de_analysis(
  fit = fit_multinom,
  X = gene_mat_balanced,
  shrink.method = "ash",
  lfc.stat = "vsnull",
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Volcano plot labeling rule
my_do_label <- function(lfc, y) {
  abs(lfc) > 2.2 | y > 45
}

# Volcano plots for selected topics
volcano_plot(
  de_results,
  k = 15,
  labels = rownames(de_results$postmean),
  do.label = my_do_label
)

volcano_plot(
  de_results,
  k = 3,
  labels = rownames(de_results$postmean),
  do.label = my_do_label
)

volcano_plot(
  de_results,
  k = 8,
  labels = rownames(de_results$postmean),
  do.label = my_do_label
)
```
